issue.title: test_override_pills_keep_narrow_top_bar_in_bounds fails on master: the pill now reads peek_active_temporary_override but the test patches get_active_temporary_override
issue.description:
tests/ace/tui/test_top_bar_order.py::test_override_pills_keep_narrow_top_bar_in_bounds fails deterministically on clean master (verified with 'git stash -u' on 4fae4e794, no other changes):

    assert default_indicator.render().plain == ' CODEX(o3)@xhigh ∞ '
    AssertionError: assert ' ... ' == ' CODEX(o3)@xhigh ∞ '

Reproduction: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ace/tui/test_top_bar_order.py::test_override_pills_keep_narrow_top_bar_in_bounds -q -p no:randomly  ->  1 failed in ~1.8s. Fails on every attempt, in isolation and under 'just test-scoped' (where it was the only failure out of 30,677).

First bad commit (git bisect, 75c670c4b good .. 233d62463 bad): 233d62463 'fix(ace): keep launch-default indicator live as the @large pool rotates' (plan 202608/ace_launch_default_indicator_liveness.md). Confirmed passing at 2fcca46eb/868f376df/5ec926227/75c670c4b and failing at every commit from 233d62463 through current master.

Root cause: that commit added peek_active_temporary_override() and, per its own message, switched the indicator's per-tick display reads to it. src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/llm_override_indicator.py now calls peek_active_temporary_override() on the render paths (lines 70, 75, 84, 142, 172, 181), leaving get_active_temporary_override() only on the off-thread resolve path (line 211). The test still monkeypatches llm_override_indicator.get_active_temporary_override, so the display path sees no override and _build_cached_default_content() returns _PLACEHOLDER_TEXT (' ... ', line 35/198) because the off-thread default resolve has not completed inside the test app.

Scope: decide whether peek_active_temporary_override is the intended display source (then repoint the test's monkeypatch at it, and check the sibling asserts in the same file that still pass) or whether the widget should fall back to the authoritative read when the peek is cold (then fix the widget). Only the default-model pill is affected; the alias and provider-disable asserts in the same test pass. Re-run the whole tests/ace/tui/test_top_bar_order.py file plus 'just check'.

Impact: 'just check' / 'just check-full' cannot go green on an otherwise-clean master for any agent, so every agent must hand-triage this node before landing.

Found while splitting tests/test_plan_filter_query.py into focused modules from workspace sase_14; that diff touches only tests/test_plan_filter_query*.py and cannot affect ACE top-bar rendering.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-mc (in-progress epic 'Temporarily Disable LLM Providers') — phase sase-mc.3 built the top-bar disabled-provider pill asserted by the very same test, so a fix editing tests/ace/tui/test_top_bar_order.py could collide with that epic's remaining work. It did not cause this failure: bisect pins the break to standalone commit 233d62463.

RELATED: sase-mf (in-progress epic 'Simplify built-in model routing and redesign the Models panel') — it owns the launch-settings/size-alias contract behind the '@medium@max' alias pill in this same test and already carries alias-migration DISCOVERED ISSUE notes, so its phase sase-mf.4 verification may touch these assertions. Not the cause of this failure.

RELATED: sase-mk (in-progress task, symvision private-import failures) and sase-mn (ready task, unused public FilesQueryIndexResult) — the other two independent reasons 'just check' is currently red on master. Fixing this node alone will not make the gate green; symvision runs before the test lane and still stops the recipe first.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction on HEAD c6d84d2a4 during the escalated full test lane: tests/ace/tui/test_top_bar_order.py::test_override_pills_keep_narrow_top_bar_in_bounds was the only failure outside sase-ml's 59-test host-runtime contamination cluster. It is unrelated to this diff, which only splits Models-panel display code; the full 313-test Models-panel suite passes.

Independent reproduction during sase-mj epic landing on master HEAD 3862288e9 (four commits past the 4fae4e794 in the description), workspace sase_14. Full escalated 'just test-scoped' run: 2 failed / 30689 passed, one of which is this node. Isolated rerun '.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ace/tui/test_top_bar_order.py::test_override_pills_keep_narrow_top_bar_in_bounds -p no:randomly' fails deterministically with assert ' ... ' == ' CODEX(o3)@xhigh ∞ '. Independently confirmed the described root cause by reading llm_override_indicator.py: peek_active_temporary_override is used on the render paths (lines 70/75/84/142/172/181) while the test patches get_active_temporary_override. My tree touches only pyproject.toml, uv.lock, and tests/test_powerful_variables_landing.py (sase-core-rs floor ratchet), none of which can reach ACE top-bar rendering. Originally surfaced as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP on closed phase sase-mj.4, which mischaracterized it as flaky; it is deterministic.
